description.value: Published on Main is a Michelin-starred fine dining restaurant in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood, led by Executive Chef Gus Stieffenhofer-Brandson, whose cooking draws on British Columbia's landscape and seasonal regional ingredients. Since opening six years ago it has held a MICHELIN Star every year from 2022 through 2025, claimed the top spot on Canada's 100 Best Restaurants, and placed among North America's 50 Best. A touring cyclist looking for a special-occasion dinner on the Main Street corridor would find polished service and a thoughtfully crafted contemporary Canadian menu here.
